segments.text: An API operation used by the Systems Manager console to display information about Systems Manager managed nodes.

[[p0]] is a paginated operation. Multiple API calls may be issued in order to retrieve the entire data set of results. You can disable pagination by providing the [[p1]] argument. When using [[p2]] and the [[p3]] argument on a paginated response, the [[p4]] argument must extract data from the results of the following query expressions: [[p5]]

If other arguments are provided on the command line, those values will override the JSON-provided values. [[p0]] (string) Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request. If provided with no value or the value [[p1]], prints a sample input JSON that can be used as an argument for [[p2]]. If provided with the value [[p5]], it validates the command inputs and returns a sample output JSON for that command.
